title: Compliance docs claim 'Compliant' and may cite the wrong Ethiopian law number
standards: Ethiopia Personal Data Protection Proclamation (number to confirm: 1309/2024 vs 1321/2024)
expected: Compliance status reflects verified controls; the governing law is cited by its correct number.
actual: The document states 'Status: Compliant (Continuous Monitoring)' while this audit confirms public identity documents (F-013) and files kept after erasure (F-014). It cites 'Proclamation No. 1309/2024' as the data-protection law; the audit brief cites 'Proclamation No. 1321/2024'. This audit does not decide which is correct.
impact: Misstated compliance can mislead investors, partners and regulators; a wrong law number undermines every derived obligation.
fix: COUNSEL: confirm the proclamation number and obligations. Change the status to 'Gaps identified — see audit 2026-11' until F-013, F-014, F-015 are fixed.
